dict.string: Piru reads your body weight to make dose and alcohol-strength estimates accurate for your body, and — if you enable it — your heart rate and blood pressure to show how your body responded during a session. Everything is read-only on your device and is never shared.
Piru reads your body weight, heart rate, and blood pressure from Health to personalize estimates and show your body's response during a session. It does not write any data back to Health.
Piru attaches the place where you took a dose so you can see it in your journal. Location is stored only on your device and is never shared.
